title: Memory Organizer
description: Use this when memoryd needs to promote raw episodes into structured graph knowledge — runs batched relation extraction, importance scoring (1–10), contradiction detection, and reflection synthesis via LLM. Invoked by memoryd on the write path; never called on the read path.
author: sox-ecosystem

invocation.description: Call organizeItems(items: OrganizerItem[], db: Database) → Promise<OrganizerResult[]>. Invoked by memoryd on the write path; never called on the read path.

provider_url.description: Base URL of the LLM provider (e.g. https://api.anthropic.com/v1). Falls back to env MEMORY_PROVIDER_URL.

provider_key.description: API key for the LLM provider. Use ${MEMORY_PROVIDER_KEY} env ref.

batch_size.description: Number of episodes processed per organizer batch (default: 10).
